input: Find a local beekeeping beginner course

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Beginner Beekeeping Course
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable beginner beekeeping course available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow the course search geographically.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for this course?
questions.description: Determine the maximum acceptable travel distance or radius from the user's location.

questions.title: Do you need the course to run on specific days or times?
questions.description: Clarify scheduling constraints such as weekends only, evenings, or full-day sessions.

questions.title: What is your target start date or timeframe for the course?
questions.description: Understand when the user wants to begin so results can be filtered by upcoming availability.

questions.title: What is your budget for the course fees?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter out courses that are too expensive or to flag free options.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person, online, or hybrid format?
questions.description: Determine the preferred delivery format so the search targets the right type of course.

questions.title: Are you planning to keep bees at home, on an allotment, or elsewhere?
questions.description: Understand the intended beekeeping context to match course content to the user's practical situation.
